source.file: chem-equilibrium/data/data.json (bundled into the library the view loads from lactame.com)
source.note: The view files contain NO inline chemistry data. Every equation, pK and species label comes from this database, shipped inside the chem-equilibrium bundle.

semantics.formed: label of the species produced by the (formation) reaction
semantics.components: map componentLabel -> stoichiometric coefficient consumed to form `formed`
semantics.pK: log10 of the formation constant beta of `formed` (beta = 10 ** pK). For type=precipitation the solubility product used by the solver is Ksp = 10 ** -pK.

publishedBundleDelta.note: The deployed views load chem-equilibrium 2.2.0 (precipitation) / 2.2.1 (free) from lactame.com. Their data.json differs from the current repo HEAD by these three rows.
